notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This address does not exist (any more).

auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A phrase or a long sentence works well; special characters are not required.

twoFactor.label: Code from your authenticator app
twoFactor.hint: 6-digit code – or a recovery code if you don't have your device.

recoveryUsed.title: Recovery code used
recoveryUsed.text_one: You are signed in. You have {{count}} recovery code left. Create new codes in your profile.
recoveryUsed.text_other: You are signed in. You have {{count}} recovery codes left. Create new codes in your profile.

register.title: Create account
register.disabled: New accounts cannot be created here. Please contact the operator of this installation.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: We will send you a link to reset your password.
forgot.sent: If an account with this email address exists, we have sent a link. It is valid for one hour.
forgot.unavailable: Resetting by email is not set up on this server. Please contact the operator.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.done: Your password has been changed. All devices were signed out.
reset.invalidToken: The link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
reset.noToken: The reset code is missing. Please open the link from the email again.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.session_required: This requires signing in through the browser.
errors.invalid_code: The code is wrong or has already been used.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
errors.too_many_attempts_wait: Too many attempts. Please wait about {{minutes}} minute(s).
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
errors.email_taken: This email address is already taken.
errors.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.password_policy: The password is not secure enough.

policy.too_long: It may have at most 128 characters.
policy.too_common: It is too simple or too common.
policy.contains_identity: It must not contain your email or name.
policy.breached: It is known from data breaches.

errors.password_required: This requires a password on your account.
errors.invalid_expiry: The expiry date must be in the future (10 years at most).
errors.too_many_tokens: At most 50 active tokens are possible.
errors.import_invalid: The file contains errors. Nothing was imported.
errors.invalid_or_expired_token: The link is invalid or has expired.
errors.forbidden_origin: The address in your browser does not match the server's APP_BASE_URL. Please adjust APP_BASE_URL in .env and restart.
errors.run_not_active: This run is archived and read-only.
errors.sso_denied: Signing in at the identity provider was cancelled.
errors.sso_failed: Signing in with SSO failed. Please try again.
errors.sso_flow_expired: The sign-in process expired. Please start it again.
errors.sso_unavailable: The identity provider is not reachable.
errors.sso_email_missing: The identity provider did not provide an email address.
errors.sso_email_not_verified: An account with this email exists, but the provider does not confirm the address. Sign in with your password and link SSO in your profile.
errors.sso_already_linked: This SSO account already belongs to another account.
errors.tag_name_taken: A tag with this name already exists.
errors.unknown_tag: At least one tag no longer exists. Please reload the page.
errors.too_deep: The nesting is too deep (50 levels at most).
errors.cycle: An item cannot be moved into itself or into its sub-items.
errors.parent_not_found: The parent item no longer exists. Please reload the page.
errors.unknown_template: At least one template no longer exists. Please reload the page.

account.title: Account
account.trashHint: The archive is never emptied automatically.
account.passwordForEmailHint: We need your password to change the email address.

password.title: Change password
password.description: After the change, all other devices are signed out.
password.none: Your account has no password (sign-in via SSO). You can set one with “Forgot password” on the sign-in page.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Extra protection: signing in requires a code from an authenticator app.
twoFactor.enabled_one: Active. You have {{count}} recovery code left.
twoFactor.enabled_other: Active. You have {{count}} recovery codes left.
twoFactor.setupIntro: You need an authenticator app (e.g. Aegis, Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Bitwarden).
twoFactor.step1: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app – or enter the key by hand.
twoFactor.step2: Then enter the 6-digit code from the app.
twoFactor.recoveryIntro: These are your recovery codes. Each works once if you lose your device. They are shown only now.
twoFactor.recoverySaved: I have saved the codes in a safe place.
twoFactor.regenerateIntro: The current codes become invalid. Confirm with a code from the app.
twoFactor.disableIntro: Afterwards the password alone is enough again. Confirm with a code from the app or a recovery code.

sso.title: Single sign-on
sso.description: Sign in with {{name}} without a separate password.
sso.unlinkIntro: Afterwards you can only sign in with your password.
sso.needPassword: The link can only be removed if your account has a password (otherwise you would be locked out).
sso.justLinked: The link has been set up.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: For scripts, automation and AI assistants (MCP). A token has the rights of its owner.
tokens.empty: You have no API tokens yet.
tokens.createdWarning: Copy the token now. For security reasons it is shown only once.
tokens.name: Name (e.g. device or application)
tokens.readHint: May retrieve data but not change anything.
tokens.writeHint: May create and edit templates and runs – not delete.
tokens.expiryHint: Without a date the token does not expire.
tokens.mcpText: Enter this address and a token in your MCP client. With a read token the assistant only sees read-only tools.

shares.title: Shared runs
shares.description: All share links at a glance. Withdrawn links stop working immediately.
shares.empty: You are not sharing any run right now.
shares.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Leave empty to keep the current password.
shares.revokeText: The link to “{{title}}” will stop working.

data.title: Data
data.description: Export your data or import templates and runs.
data.exportHint: You can export single templates and runs later directly there as JSON, CSV or Markdown. The account export additionally contains your profile and trash, but no passwords or tokens.
data.importHint: JSON (export format) or CSV with the columns template, level, title, description. Imports always create new entries; you check a preview first.
data.csvTitle: Template name (only if the CSV has no “Vorlage” column)
data.csvTitleHint: All rows go into this one template.
data.issues_one: {{count}} problem found – nothing will be imported:
data.issues_other: {{count}} problems found – nothing will be imported:
data.previewOk: Ready to import: {{templates}} templates, {{runs}} runs, {{items}} items.
data.alwaysNew: The import always creates new entries and never overwrites anything.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Irrevocably deletes your account with all templates, runs, tags, tokens and shares.
delete.needPassword: Deleting requires a password on your account. Set one with “Forgot password”.
delete.warning: All your data is deleted immediately and irrevocably. Export it first if you want to keep it.

tags.title: Manage tags
tags.intro: Tags mark templates with a colour. They apply to templates only, not to runs.
tags.newHint: The colour is chosen automatically so that it differs clearly from your other tags. You can change it later.

templates.empty: You have no templates yet. Create your first one – for example a packing list.
templates.deleteText: “{{title}}” is moved to the trash and can be restored there. Runs that were already started stay unchanged.

editor.notFound: This template does not exist (any more).
editor.noTags: No tags yet – create the first one below.
editor.itemsHint: {{count}} items in total. Drag the handle ⋮⋮ to reorder – or use the buttons ↑ ↓ ← →.
editor.exportHint: Download as a file: JSON (complete, can be imported again), CSV (table) or Markdown (readable, printable).

items.empty: This template has no items yet.
items.addHint: Press Enter to add – the field stays active for the next item.
items.dragHint: Drag to move; dragging right/left changes the level
items.deleteWithChildren_one: “{{title}}” will be deleted together with {{count}} sub-item.
items.deleteWithChildren_other: “{{title}}” will be deleted together with {{count}} sub-items.

a11y.instructions: To move, press the space bar, move with the up or down arrow keys and press the space bar to drop. Escape cancels. Use the buttons on the item to indent or outdent.

runs.pickHint: Pick any number of templates. Each becomes its own section, in the order you chose them. Without a template you start with an empty run.
runs.noTemplates: You have no templates yet. Create some under
runs.empty: No active run yet. Start one from one or more templates.
runs.archiveIntro: Archived runs are kept permanently and are read-only. You can reopen them.
runs.deleteText: “{{title}}” is moved to the trash and can be restored there.
runs.readOnly: This run is archived and read-only. Reopen it to edit.
runs.addTemplatesHint: The templates are appended as new sections. Later changes to a template do not affect this run.
runs.sectionHint: For items that are not in any template.
runs.completeText: The run is done and moved to the trash. You can restore it there until it is deleted automatically.
runs.archiveText: The run is kept permanently. A share link is ended.
runs.completedNotice: “{{title}}” was completed and is in the trash.
runs.deleteItemText: “{{title}}” and all its sub-items will be deleted.
runs.removeSectionText: The section “{{title}}” is removed with all its items.

share.title: Share run
share.intro: Create a link that lets others view or edit this run without an account.
share.activeIntro: Anyone with this link has access – as configured below.
share.passwordRequired: Please enter a password with at least 8 characters.
share.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current password.
share.regenerated: There is a new link now.
share.regenerateHint: A new link immediately invalidates the old one.

trash.retention: Items are deleted permanently after {{days}} days. Set the period in your profile.
trash.retentionNever: Items stay in the trash until you delete them.
trash.emptyText_one: The one entry will be deleted irrevocably.
trash.emptyText_other: All {{count}} entries will be deleted irrevocably.

publicRun.passwordText: This run is protected with a password.
publicRun.invalid: This link is invalid or has been ended.
publicRun.viewOnly: You can view this run. It updates automatically.
publicRun.canEdit: You can check, add and delete items. Changes are visible to everyone immediately.

offline.offline: You are offline. Changes to items are saved on this device and sent as soon as a connection is available again.
offline.pending_one: {{count}} change is waiting to be sent.
offline.pending_other: {{count}} changes are waiting to be sent.
offline.conflicts_one: {{count}} change could not be sent and was discarded:
offline.conflicts_other: {{count}} changes could not be sent and were discarded:

reason.not_found: The item, section or run no longer exists.
reason.run_not_active: The run has been archived in the meantime.
